column4: AMENDMENT OF PART II OF THE FINANCE ACT, NO. 11 OF 2004
Part II of the Finance Act, No.11 of 2004 is hereby

column3: amended as in subsection (2) of section 14 thereof, by the
substitution for the words “for the period ending on February
29,  2008”  of  the  words  “for  the  period  commencing  on
February 29, 2008 and ending on December 31, 2010.”.

column4: It is hereby declared for the avoidance of doubts that

column3: the provisions of Part II of the Finance Act No.11 of 2004
shall not apply to any person to whom the provisions of that
Part applied prior to January 1, 2011.

column4: (1) The Minister may make regulations in respect of

column3: all matters in respect of which regulations are required or
authorized  to  be  made  or  in  respect  of  matters  which  are
required to be prescribed by this Act.

column4: (2)  Every  regulation  made  by  the  Minister  shall  be

column3: published in the Gazette and shall come into operation on
the date of such publication or on such later date as may be
specified in the regulation.

column4: (3) Every regulation made by the Minister, shall, as soon

column3: as convenient after its publication in the Gazette, be brought
before Parliament for approval. Any regulation which is not
so approved shall deemed to be rescinded as from the date of
disapproval  but  without  prejudice  to  anything  previously
done there under.

column4: (4)  Notification  of  the  date  on  which  any  regulation  is

column3: deemed  under  subsection  (3)  to  be  rescinded  shall  be
published in the Gazette.
